ir.name: all_pairs_gap_bandpass_simple_reweight
ir.intuition: Reweight all pairs by a smooth bandpass on gap normalized by instance_obj_range, emphasizing medium gaps and modulating by inverse instance_log_prob_std to reflect confidence, preserving full topology and no normalization.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    eps = 1e-6
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_bandpass_simple_reweight', 'weight_family': 'gap_bandpass'})
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    instance_obj_range = feature_cache['instance_obj_range']
    instance_log_prob_std = feature_cache['instance_log_prob_std']
    gap_scaled = gap / instance_obj_range[b_idx].clamp_min(eps)
    low_cut = float(extra.get('low_cut', 0.2))
    high_cut = float(extra.get('high_cut', 1.2))
    rise = (gap_scaled - low_cut) / (high_cut - low_cut)
    fall = (high_cut - gap_scaled) / (high_cut - low_cut)
    rise = rise.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    fall = fall.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    raw_weight = rise * fall
    inv_log_prob_std = 1.0 / instance_log_prob_std[b_idx].clamp_min(eps)
    raw_weight = raw_weight * inv_log_prob_std
    raw_weight = raw_weight.clamp(min=0.0)
    weight = raw_weight.clamp(min=0.25, max=4.0)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_bandpass_simple_reweight', 'weight_family': 'gap_bandpass'})

ir.name: weighted_advantage_exp_margin_logsigmoid_scaled_weighted_mean_loss_v4_fixed_cv
ir.intuition: This loss uses weighted advantages between winner and loser in pairwise comparisons, scaling margin exponentially with the mean advantage gap to stabilize training and emphasize confident differences, with clamped weights to ensure numeric stability and avoid zero-weight issues.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-6
lpw=batch['log_prob_w']
lpl=batch['log_prob_l']
weight=ops.clamp(batch['weight'], eps, None) + eps
advantage_gap=batch.get('advantage_gap', zeros) + eps
mean_adv=mean(advantage_gap)
margin=exp(clamp(abs(mean_adv),0,1)) - 1
norm=max(mean(norm(advantage_gap)), eps)
x_raw=(lpw - lpl) / norm
x=margin * x_raw
x=clamp(x,-20,20)
loss=-logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted=loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight_raw = batch['weight']
    weight = ops.clamp(weight_raw, eps, None)
    weight = ops.add(weight, eps)
    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
    advantage_gap = batch.get('advantage_gap', zeros)
    advantage_gap = ops.add(advantage_gap, eps)
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    margin = ops.sub(ops.exp(ops.clamp(ops.abs(mean_adv), 0.0, 1.0)), 1.0)
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), eps)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.sum(weight))
    return loss_mean
